provider.name: Vast.ai
provider.summary: A marketplace where hosts set their own prices. Each figure is a floor - the median of the five cheapest verified single-GPU offers - withheld when too few offers are listed. Machines with several GPUs are a separate row.
provider.notes: auction pricing, API only; trimmed floor of the 5 cheapest verified single-GPU offers, withheld when the window cannot carry a floor (fewer than 3 offers, or a median over 3x the cheapest ask)

fees.value: GPU rate includes a GPU-proportional share of host CPU and RAM; storage and bandwidth priced separately
Set by each host per offer ($/TB), charged on every byte up and down, in any instance state; no platform-wide rate
Set by each host per offer, charged on allocated disk size; no platform-wide price
GPU rental stops; storage keeps billing until the instance is deleted (bandwidth billed in any state)
Per second while active; credits must be prepaid; no minimum charge published
